congestion.notes: SIM MODEL. Travel-time factor per (segment, hour) = 1 + k * (flow_pce / capacity_vph), capped at max_factor. flow_pce is the day's actual simulated vehicle flow on the segment in that hour (passenger-car equivalents below); capacity_vph is roads.py's class capacity from the merged design. Routing uses the PREVIOUS day's peak factor per segment (drivers plan around the worst hour they experienced); travel times use the trip's own departure-hour factor of the current day.

emergency.notes: SIM MODEL: an ambulance's travel time takes half the congestion/condition load of ordinary traffic (priority). Clinic trips depart at the configured hour (visits are day-granular records in Session 06).

emissions_kg_per_unit.notes: SIM MODEL emission factors (kg CO2 per litre of petrol/diesel, per kg of CNG), recorded per trip from vehicles.json consumption figures so Session 08 can consume them. Not measured data.

freight.notes: Freight shipments physicalise Session 04's supply orders and Session 03/04's intercity trade flows. The freight CHARGE is Session 04's own shipping amount (already in the ledger via market.py); Session 07 adds the journey: vehicle, route, departure, congested arrival, delay. Carrier trucks are SYS-MARKET fleet vehicles for sellers without a truck of their own.

intercity.notes: Road crossing over Session 03's RC-ROAD-1 bridge connection. crossing_distance_m matches the +1.5 km convention Session 04's market._distance_km already uses for intercity routes; crossing_min is SIM MODEL (bridge + toll plaza at the District 1 approach, GDD-02 section 4).

maintenance.notes: SIM MODEL: vehicle condition wears with distance and is restored by a recorded service event under the threshold (no per-event price exists in prices.json; owners' upkeep is the monthly band, fleet upkeep is the operator's).

mode_choice.notes: SIM MODEL behaviour parameters. Walk speed is a modelling constant; cycle/rickshaw cruise speeds are vehicles.json's own traffic_cruise_kmh values. Fare policy is data-grounded, not modelled: bus / rickshaw / ferry travel is covered by the monthly living-cost line transport_public_bus_rickshaw that prices.json already charges non-car households at settlement (fare 0 at point of use); taxi hire is charged per trip at prices.json taxi_fares; own vehicles cost nothing per trip (owners already pay the monthly transport_own_car_fuel_upkeep band).

road_condition.notes: Road state feeds routing: a segment's travel time grows as its Session 03 condition falls (factor 1 + (100 - condition)/100 * slowdown_at_zero_condition), and a segment under the critical condition — or explicitly closed (road_segments.closed) — is impassable and routes must detour. Session 05's infrastructure policy repairs raise condition and therefore measurably speed routes up.

source: Session 07 — Transportation, Mobility & Smart Infrastructure. Structure grounded in merged data: vehicle classes, road classes, capacities and fuel consumption from data/vehicles.json + tools/sim/roads.py; taxi fares REFERENCED from data/prices.json (never copied); transit stops are real zone ids; the ferry is Session 03's persisted RC-FERRY-1 connection. Every rate that has no design-data basis is labelled SIM MODEL here and in docs/SESSION-07-REPORT.md.

subsidy.notes: SIM MODEL public-transport subsidy: the municipal treasury (Session 05) pays the transit operator (SYS-MARKET) per recorded boarding, capped monthly per city, only when the government layer exists and the treasury balance covers it. Ferry boardings are subsidised by the origin city (Rupsha).

tanks.notes: SIM MODEL tank capacities in the vehicle's fuel_unit from vehicles.json (litres, or kg for CNG). vehicles.json defines consumption per 100 km but no tank size; no fuel PRICE exists in prices.json, so fuel is tracked as a quantity only and is never charged per trip.

transit_routes.crossing_notes: SIM MODEL crossing time/distance: the two ghats live in different city coordinate frames (Session 03 regional.py), so no shared metric exists in the data.
transit_routes.name: Rupsha - Shibnagar Ferry (Session 03 connection)

vehicle_purchase.notes: SIM MODEL behaviour: a monthly sweep in which an employed adult with no vehicle and a balance of at least balance_multiple x the prices.json price may buy (seeded chance), choosing the most expensive class their balance supports among bicycle / rickshaw_own / motorbike / car_small / car_premium. taxi_licensed is excluded: taxi drivers rent by the settlement's design. Payment is a ledger transfer to SYS-MARKET at the prices.json price.
